node.title: Re: Devel::Peek Dump() not printing out
node.author: haukex
node.doctext:
Hi [ultranerds],

Works for me. Can you post an [id://1177642|SSCCE] that reproduces the problem on your end? Note that [doc://Devel::Peek] prints to STDERR, are you sure you're not redirecting that to somewhere else?

$ perl -wMstrict -MDevel::Peek -e 'Dump("foo");' SV = PV(0x21783a0) at 0x20a31e0 REFCNT = 1 FLAGS = (POK,IsCOW,READONLY,PROTECT,pPOK) PV = 0x20b7f20 "foo"\0 CUR = 3 LEN = 10 COW_REFCNT = 0

Regards,
-- Hauke D
